headword: {神経|しんけい}{衰弱|すいじゃく}

definitions.explanation: Mental and physical exhaustion from prolonged stress, with irritability, poor sleep and trouble concentrating. As a medical term (neurasthenia) it is dated.
A memory game in which cards are laid face down and turned over two at a time to find matching pairs.
